purpose_zh: 把人优先、机器让路从叙述转成可复核的进入、暂缓、停止、恢复与退役契约。
purpose_en: Turn humans-first yielding from narrative into reviewable entry, hold, stop, recovery, and retirement contracts.
claim_limit_zh: 不是现场试验、交通安全认证、政府许可、公众满意度或已经运行的服务。
claim_limit_en: Not field testing, traffic-safety certification, government authorisation, public satisfaction, or an operating service.
pass_meaning_zh: 仅表示十张卡字段完整、18个合成判断与预期一致、五个安全门在缺失时失败关闭。
pass_meaning_en: Only that ten cards are complete, 18 synthetic decisions match expectations, and five safety guards fail closed when absent.
